data.decision_reason: The explicit Fourier tail and interpolation argument fills the Gaussian-reference convergence insertion left open in the P-06/P-09 audit. It closes only the fixed-volume grid-to-loop analytic interface; theorem applicability, spatial accumulation, operator common core, pressure tangent and independent referee review remain separate.
data.finding: At fixed finite spatial volume, the discrete massive periodic Gaussian covariance converges uniformly on the time circle to G_a(tau)=(1/beta)*sum_n exp(2*pi*i*n*tau/beta)/(a+4*pi^2*m*n^2/beta^2). Piecewise-linear interpolation has vanishing L2 vertex error and the existing increment moments give C_per tightness, hence weak convergence of the Gaussian reference. The residual Q3LOCK Riemann sums converge uniformly on compact loop sets, the quartic lower bound supplies a mesh-uniform weight envelope, Jensen keeps the normalizer positive, and the exact cyclic source identity plus Holder-Young gives the source-derivative passage.
method: Diagonalize the massive cyclic precision and rewrite the vertex covariance using least-absolute Fourier representatives.
Use the sine lower bound and a summable n^-2 majorant to prove covariance convergence to the periodic Green kernel for m*(-d^2/dtau^2)+a.
Bound the interpolation-to-vertex error by the exact cyclic increment estimate and combine finite-dimensional convergence with Kolmogorov tightness.
Prove uniform residual Riemann-sum convergence on Arzela-Ascoli compact sets while carrying the kinetic term in the Gaussian reference.
Combine the mesh-uniform residual envelope, Jensen denominator and quartic source uniform integrability to pass bounded tests and source derivatives.
